title: Create src/lib/feature/prdWriter.ts — append feature spec to PRD.md
description: Create a module that appends a feature spec to PRD.md. If '## Features Added' section exists, appends there; otherwise creates the section at the end. Does not duplicate content.
acceptanceCriteria: Appends spec under '## Features Added' if section exists
Creates '## Features Added' section if it doesn't exist
Existing PRD content before the section is unchanged
Running twice with the same spec does not duplicate the section

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra and path.

export async function writeFeatureSpec(specMarkdown: string, prdPath: string): Promise<string> { const content = await fs.readFile(prdPath, 'utf-8').catch(() => ''); const section = '## Features Added'; if (content.includes(section)) { await fs.writeFile(prdPath, content + '
' + specMarkdown, 'utf-8'); return section } else { await fs.writeFile(prdPath, content + '

' + section + '

' + specMarkdown, 'utf-8'); return section } }
Before appending, check if specMarkdown is already in the content: if (content.includes(specMarkdown.slice(0, 100))) { return section }. This prevents duplicate appends.

technicalNotes: Using the first 100 chars of specMarkdown for the idempotency check is a reasonable heuristic — feature titles are unique
